lens: guided device diagnostics, measurement truth, recovery and export
scope: internal iOS source and Simulator guided capture

verification.export: system Files save plus exact byte readback

resolved_findings.finding: Banner stop target had visual padding but only an approximately 20-point accessible target.
resolved_findings.correction: Define a content shape over the 44-point label frame.
resolved_findings.proof: The passing native journey verifies target height and workspace navigation.

resolved_findings.finding: Exporting an old in-memory report could replace corrupt stored data.
resolved_findings.correction: Require readable storage before export and preserve corrupted bytes until explicit clearing.
resolved_findings.proof: The unit test retains a valid in-memory report, corrupts disk and verifies export does not overwrite it.
